checked_ok_disputes.problem: Should not be marked OK. Md.14(2) fixes a semester at 14 weeks including midterms, and a comparable 2025 directive (DEÜ Md.8) requires a makeup for every unheld hour, so held equals planned there. No İÜ text supports a held-hours base. With held hours, every cancelled class without makeup shrinks the allowance (42 planned vs 36 held hours: hak 12 vs 10), so students with 11 or 12 absent hours flip from DEVAMLI to DEVAMSIZ. The plan states the base as decided; it is an open assumption that changes outcomes. See the miss on line 377.

verdict_reason: Both high findings hold against primary sources. S14-01 is CONFIRMED: Md.19(3) plus İÜ calendars that put the absence-entry deadline on the last class day (Eczacılık 02.01.2026, 12.06.2026) or 2 days later (graduate, 04.01.2026).
